scope: Interim seven completed paired cases only. This is not a V5 cohort analysis; no aggregate Found/collision rate is computed.

definitions.state_step: Initial state 0 plus each transition after state, including terminal. Query counts in the event are from the transition ending at that state.
definitions.completed_goal_wait_run: Contiguous pre-Found states with assignment_kind=search, hold=false, tracker_completed=true, distance to unchanged semantic goal<=0.75; counts states, not motion-stall steps and not zero detection ability.
definitions.evidence_renewal_proxy: Actual negative-target-evidence cell stamps: a physical step with new cells or an aged revisit. It is not detection probability; stationary reobservation retains detection ability.
definitions.field_equality: Compared fields: position,velocity,semantic_waypoint,tracking_waypoint,hold,assignment_id,planned_path,path_index. Field equality does not establish full public-map or physical-signature equality.
definitions.causal_limit: Paired outcome differences follow divergent full trajectories. No local controller event is claimed to be the isolated cause of later Found or collision.

mechanism_findings.finding: V3 contains prolonged completed-goal waits and strict atomic-coupling examples; V5 has no motion-stall proxy steps or atomic missing-route events in this case and at most three completed-goal waiting states, but both still time out without Found. Removing waits is useful and not sufficient for discovery.

V5 finds at 295 versus V3 at 160 and V4 never. V3 contains long completed-goal waits before its earlier discovery; more movement or evidence-renewal proxy steps cannot be equated with monotonically earlier target encounter.

V5 still atomically rejects an available replacement for completed agent 0 when agent 1 candidate generation has invalid_start. The fatal agent 1 trajectory equals V4 across all 85 states, but global public-map equality is not established.

V5 survives 400 with no Found, while V3 collides at 229 and V4 at 393. It refreshes the stale query state at state 115 and obtains reachable candidates; the later survival difference is not attributed to this single event.

V4 and V5 positions, velocities, guidance and hold states match at all 15 states including terminal, and the fatal collision record matches. Agent 2 still moves at speed 0.940635 at hold state 12 and 0.712891 at hold state 13 before collision 14. Changed query/refresh metadata does not make hold an instantaneous stop.
V4 and V5 identical full signature: Found 23 and timeout 400.
V3, V4 and V5 identical full signature: Found 18 and success 120.

limitations: Only requested completed indices are included; remaining V5 arms are not inspected or counted.
No complete live public occupancy probability grids are in these traces. Cached map summaries and query failures cannot date first obstacle observation.
Index 7 prior public-map replay was for V4. Shared fatal-agent positions do not transfer its cell-probability evidence to V5.
No claim is made that unchanged/small new-cell coverage means zero target detection capability.
